reuse.why: Reuses extractTagsFromText for the #fixed tag, getSheetValue and the sum-amount sheet cells for last month's spending, and the existing mutator/undoable wiring for the new handler.

duplication.why: Replaces three copied category queries and copyPreviousMonth's own hidden check with one getMonthWideCategories selector; the new action repeats only the per-action income/tracking guard and the expense sign flip that the other actions already carry.

placement.why: The selection rule lives in budget/actions.ts beside the actions that use it, and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts with the others.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps: the shared selector, its use in each month-wide action, the new action and its registration, and tests.

maintainability.why: One documented selector with a single real option makes the exclusion rules easy to own, though copyPreviousMonth still loads hidden flags via getBudgetData that it no longer uses and the income/tracking rule stays repeated per action.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts gains the includeHiddenCategories parameter and a conditional hidden SQL filter; every month-wide action (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg, setLastMonthSpending) calls it.
